limitations: All ordinary entrances and 6m spur alignments are derived proposals until R7 building/road geometry is frozen; do not export to Runtime CampusData.

The 6m centerline clearance check is planar against rectangular footprint envelopes only; detailed wall offsets, doors, curb widths, bridge widths, vertical grades and vehicle turning are not reviewed.
R6 coordinates remain provisional and may conflict with R7 candidates; no R6 geometry is promoted to R7 final.
FIRE-SPUR status CLEARANCE_PRECHECK_ONLY does not prove continuous fire-vehicle travel from emergency city entry, nor compliance with full emergency vehicle turning.
Hospital HSP-02 is part of HSP-01, HSP-03 connects internally and MUST NOT be a duplicate independent hospital ground floor; separate city emergency and social access retained.
C/D changes in SOLVE-09 prohibit active D-axis crossing; SOLVE-08 cancelled D-CROSS corridors are not used for ordinary derived fire roads.
Roads SOLVE-07 remain conditional; stop shifts/terminal spaces SOLVE-10 are not finalized.
No final fire stand-off distances, hydrants, doors, lift, firetruck stabilization, swept path, gradient, and full 18 audits.
